info.name: Didit Verification Cases API
info.description: Identity verification API. Authenticate with x-api-key header.

request.description: Assign the case to a user, or unassign it by sending assignee_user_id: null. assignee_email/assignee_name auto-provision a User row when the assignee does not exist yet.

Resolve the case as false_positive or valid_threat. Blocked with 400 if the blueprint's checklist is not optional and items remain incomplete, or if the blueprint requires a resolution note and none is given. When the case's blueprint has a four_eyes_checker_blueprint configured, the resolution is staged (case.pending_resolution) and the case moves to the checker blueprint instead of resolving immediately; a different user must call approve or reject-approval.

response.name: Incomplete checklist items, or a resolution note is required.

request.description: Move an awaiting-user or resolved case back to open, clearing resolution, resolution_notes, resolved_at, and resolved_by_email.
Move an open case to awaiting_user while more information is collected from the verified user. Fails with 400 if a resolution is currently pending 4-eyes approval.
Move the case to its blueprint's configured escalation_blueprint. Requires the current blueprint to have escalation_enabled and an escalation_blueprint set, otherwise 400.
Move the case to a different, active blueprint of the same application. Requires the current blueprint to have transfer_enabled, otherwise 400.
Apply a resolution staged by resolve on a maker blueprint. The caller must be a different user than the one who submitted it, otherwise 403.

response.name: The caller is the same user who submitted the resolution (or the case has no recorded maker); a different officer must approve it.
Case has no resolution pending approval.

request.description: Reject a resolution staged by resolve and return the case to its maker blueprint. The caller must be a different user than the one who submitted it, otherwise 403.

response.name: Resolution rejected, case returned to the maker blueprint.
The caller is the same user who submitted the resolution (or the case has no recorded maker); a different officer must reject it.
Case has no resolution pending approval.

request.description: Render the full case (summary, subject, checklist state, notes, attached sessions/transactions, events, FIU report list) as a PDF and return a presigned download URL.
Upload a file (JPEG, PNG, WebP, PDF, plain text, or CSV; max 5 MB) to attach to a note. Returns the s3_key to pass in the note's attachments array.

response.name: No file, unsupported content type, or file exceeds 5 MB.

query.description: (Required) The attachment's s3_key, as returned by upload or listed on the note.

request.description: Mint a fresh presigned download URL for an attachment already stored on one of the case's notes.

query.description: (Required) The attachment's s3_key, as returned by upload or listed on the note.

response.name: s3_key missing or does not belong to this case.

query.description: (Required) The attachment's s3_key, as returned by upload or listed on the note.

request.description: Detach a linked session, business session, or transaction from the case.
List sessions, business sessions, and transactions attached to the case.
Attach a session, business session, or transaction to the case. Rejected with 400 if the entity belongs to a different subject than the case.

response.name: Entity belongs to a different profile than the case subject.

request.description: Read-only audit timeline of the case (created, status changes, assignment, resolution, escalation, transfers, tag/priority/due-date changes, entity actions, and more).

request.description: Mark a checklist item complete or incomplete. Resolution is blocked while any item is incomplete, unless the blueprint marks the checklist optional.
List the case's checklist items, copied from the blueprint's content_config.checklist.items at creation, ordered.
List AML screening hits for the case's subject. Same shape as the hits returned by POST /v3/aml/.
Retrieve a case with its subject, blueprint, notes, events, links, and checklist.

response.name: Case (or nested resource) not found in this application.

request.description: Update the case's title, priority, due date, or tags. Logs PRIORITY_CHANGED/DUE_DATE_CHANGED/TAG_ADDED/TAG_REMOVED events as applicable.
Delete a case. There is no undelete endpoint.

request.description: Aggregate case analytics for the date range (defaults to the last 30 days; max 731 days). Charts, tables, totals, assignment events, and current queue counts use the same application-scoped filters. Filters use current case values. Dates apply to each metric event, so older cases assigned or resolved during the period remain included. Queue depth is independent of the date range. Invalid filters return 400; an unknown blueprint or assignee returns an empty result.

request.description: Apply the same status transition to several cases in one call: OPEN reopens, AWAITING_USER requests info, RESOLVED resolves (resolution required). Each case is evaluated independently; gate failures (incomplete checklist, missing required note) are reported per case without aborting the batch.
Assign (or unassign, with assignee_user_id: null) several cases at once. All cases must share the same blueprint; mismatches are reported per case without aborting the batch.
